summary: Trivial wrapper: retrieves the per-thread data block via TLSValueRetrievalWithInit() and returns the pointer advanced by 3 DWORD units (12 bytes). Its many file- and error-handling callers use the result as a base from which to reach offset slots in the per-thread block, consistent with the TLS_Offset_Getter ABI lead.

operations.description: Invoke TLSValueRetrievalWithInit() to obtain the per-thread data block pointer.
Advance the returned pointer by 3 DWORD units (12 bytes).

unresolved: The meaning of the +3 DWORD offset (which TLS slot it selects) is not determinable from this packet alone.
The internals of the callee TLSValueRetrievalWithInit (init semantics, failure behavior) are outside this function's evidence.
